text:
maya: Quick sync — thinking about a pragmatic path for our internal API surface. Do we push for gRPC+proto everywhere, or keep JSON REST at the edge and transcode at the gateway? Need to consider quota propagation, per-tenant billing, and console metrics.
oliver: short answer: mixing is fine but we need a deterministic contract for quota headers and telemetry. not every client can do proto.
ravi: +1. if we transcode at the gateway we must preserve identity + tenant headers so cost attribution stays accurate. otherwise billing is garbage.
maya: example header we care about: `x-rdwd-tenant-id` and `x-rdwd-auth-method`. Also want per-route token counts for console.
anna: telemetry angle: spans should indicate transport and decode step. prefer gateway emit two spans: `gateway.request` and `gateway.transcode` so we can separate transport failures vs backend errors.
kevin: operational concerns: retries across transcode boundaries can duplicate token accounting unless gateway de-dupes or we count on idempotency keys. how do we avoid double-billing?
oliver: we can add an `x-rdwd-request-id` and have the billing service dedupe within a short window. cheap and effective.
ravi: what about performance? protobuf over HTTP/2 is tighter, but many browsers/clients still prefer JSON over HTTP/1.1. do we force gRPC-web everywhere? that'll be a big UX lift for product teams.
maya: that's why I'm leaning to JSON at outer perimeter + grpc between gateway and internal backends. leaves us freedom to evolve internal schema.
anna: for quotas: gateway should resolve quota claims using the canonical tenant id header before transcode. pseudo config: 
```
quota_policy:
  claim_from: header(x-rdwd-tenant-id)
  allow_fallback_cookie: true
  dedupe_key: header(x-rdwd-request-id)
```
kevin: looks reasonable. also add `transport=proto|json` on metric labels so console can filter.
oliver: devex/rollout note: we should ship this behind a gateway flag and do a canary with feature gates per-tenant. avoid global flip.
maya: agree. plan: 1) gateway header/spec PR (tenant+request-id+transport label) 2) quick telemetry spans change 3) billing dedupe logic 4) canary rollout 5) docs + SDK hints.
ravi: one more: for SDKs, include a small shim that emits the tenant header automatically to reduce human error.
kevin: question for security: are we okay trusting `x-rdwd-tenant-id` from outside? should force auth proxy to synthesize it after authn.
maya: yes — gateway must overwrite external tenant header after validating token. don't trust client-supplied tenant. add that to the spec.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for `gateway/transport-spec-v1` started at 2026-03-18T14:12:04Z (:rocket:)
anna: tiny UX thing — in Console rollout UI surface, show transport and transcode errors as separate columns, otherwise SRE tickets get noisy.
maya: will add to console ticket. tagging @oliver @ravi for review of the gateway spec PR. thanks all.
